_comment: How the build treats all-caps code-like names (isCode in bucket-names.mjs). Two reviewed lists. `legit` = a genuine colloquial abbreviation, correct on Wikidata as a short name; it enters the word list, but only if it clears the skribbl-suitability rule (3+ letters, letters only: U.S. / HK / UK are legit yet stay out of lists). `acknowledged` = reviewed and not whitelisted (an ISO or technical code Wikidata mis-files under P1813, a shouty all-caps official name, or just too rare to use); it never enters a list, and the build drops it like any unreviewed code. Extend both from _untracked/Prompts/Whitelist_Colloquial_Abbreviations.md.
